item.title: Escambia County Approves $8 Million To Resurface 47 Roads
item.description: The Escambia County Commission recently approved $8 million to resurface 47 roads across the county. The commission voted to advance 2027 funds of $2,048,705 to 2026 for arterial and collector (higher traffic) roads in District 3 and District 5 such as W Street, Kingsfield Road, and Chemstrand Road.
